steps.en: Require the driver inside an ngx_lua handler
steps.zh: 在 ngx_lua 处理器里引入驱动
steps.code: local redis = require "resty.redis" · local red = redis:new()

steps.en: Set timeouts, then connect to a Redis server
steps.zh: 先设超时，再连 Redis 服务

steps.en: The connection rides the cosocket: while Redis answers, the worker keeps serving other requests
steps.zh: 连接挂在 cosocket 上：等 Redis 时 worker 不阻塞

steps.en: Call Redis commands as lowercase Lua methods
steps.zh: 把 Redis 命令当小写 Lua 方法调

steps.en: Batch commands into one round trip
steps.zh: 把多条命令压成一次往返

steps.en: Sends pipelined commands as one trip and hands back ordered results as a Lua table
steps.zh: pipeline 一次发出，按序返回 Lua 表结果

steps.en: Return the socket to the pool at the end of the request
steps.zh: 请求结束前把 socket 归还连接池

steps.en: The next request reuses the pooled connection — no reconnect, no re-auth per request
steps.zh: 下一个请求直接复用池中连接——不再重连、不再每请求鉴权

value.en: Redis-backed edge logic that never stalls an NGINX worker — pooling and pipelining included
value.zh: Redis 支撑的边缘逻辑永不卡住 NGINX worker——连接池与 pipeline 都已内置
